name: write_file
description: Write content to a file, replacing its entire contents (no append/merge); returns the absolute path. temp=true writes under the per-session temp dir; otherwise use an absolute or working-directory-relative path.

file_path.description: Absolute or working-directory-relative when temp=false; relative filename when temp=true (absolute paths rejected).

content.description: Full file content to write (overwrites existing file).

temp.description: Write under the per-session temp directory for scratch/intermediate files (scripts, data dumps, fixtures); cleaned up when the session ends. (default: false)
